sourceNotes.rawContent:
Add timeless elegance to your jewellery collection with this beautifully crafted Traditional Meenakari Bracelet Watch. Designed with an antique gold finish, delicate ivory meenakari detailing, sparkling red and green stones, and charming pearl bead drops, this bracelet watch is a perfect blend of traditional artistry and modern functionality.
Ideal for weddings, festive occasions, Navratri, Teej, Karwa Chauth, Diwali, and party wear, this adjustable bracelet watch pairs beautifully with sarees, lehengas, salwar suits, and Indo-western outfits.
Features
-
Premium antique gold finish
-
Elegant Meenakari craftsmanship
-
Red & green stone embellishments
-
Pearl drop detailing
-
Adjustable chain for a comfortable fit
-
Lightweight & skin-friendly
-
Perfect for festive, bridal & party wear
-
Great gifting option for women & girls
Package Includes: 1 Traditional Meenakari Bracelet Watch
